simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to גַּעַשׁ (H1608) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-loc.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: גַּעַשׁ (Gaʻash) means Gaash , a hill in Palestine First listed occurrence: 1Chr 11 32.

definitions.full: H1608. Gaash [ גַּ֫עַשׁ ] proper name, of a location הַרגָּֿ֑עַשׁ Josh 24:30 ; Judg 2:9 mountain in Ephraim, south of (חֶרֶסׅ תִּמְנַתסֶֿרַח q. v.; גָּ֑עַשׁ נַחֲלֵי 2Sam 23:30 = 1Chr 11:32 of ravines thereon, or near by.
